classification_scheme.open_attribution: Open data (OGL-C / provincial equivalent) — commercial use OK WITH attribution.
classification_scheme.restricted: Redistribution or commercial use restricted — requires legal sign-off before paywalling.
classification_scheme.unknown: Unclassified — manual review required before go-live.

go_live_gate: Free tier (discovery/metadata only, per #815) MUST only expose open/open_attribution sources. Restricted/unknown sources must NOT be in the Free subset and require legal review before Pro gating.
